title: Four states in blocks

techniques.name: Helix step

block.label: Block size
block.note: Size of every step block against the spacing of the flight: held where the blocks neither part into chips nor overlap.

yaw.label: Yaw
yaw.note: Turns every block about its own vertical axis; past ±0.3 neighbors interpenetrate.

pitch.label: Viewing angle
pitch.note: How steeply the blocks are seen from above, against the page’s own view.

lift.label: Offered lift
lift.note: How high the offered strand floats off the line, against the page’s: low, it is barely offered; high, it is held out.

strike.label: Strike angle
strike.note: The angle of the stroke drawn through the struck strand, from a flat cancel to a steep cross-out.

mark.label: Mark size
mark.note: Size of the app’s four state marks above the strands (ring, dashed ring, open arc, stroke).

techniques.implementation: A record is laid out as steps that climb a helix; a figure, a crystal or a state marker stands on a step. Drawn by the source page’s own code, with its stair, block, sun and crystal helpers given dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: flight · one block to an exchange, on the helix
